rule: Every rule the structural schemas cannot express (D-43's split). Each rule names its Chapter 0 basis, the library function that enforces it, and the parity test proving the schema alone passes a payload the rule rejects. The checker verifies every rule id appears in the harness.

rules.statement: source_domain.authority_location equals the bound RepositoryAuthorityDeclaration's authority_location.
source_domain.repository_id equals the bound declaration's repository_id.
A SOURCE_MODIFYING contract's target_ref equals the bound declaration's canonical_ref.

remote_verification_mode present requires authority_location REMOTE (payload-local and against the bound declaration); READ_ONLY forbids a mode. Publication-mode fit is deliberately not a freeze rejection: a MEDIATED-bound source contract freezes and waits at BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_FINALIZER — INV-64 and t-s04 own that gate (RV-60, D-54).

finalization_requirements equals the set derived from (finalization_class, authority_location, remote_verification_mode): RO {}; SL {LOCAL_CANONICAL_COMMIT}; SRD {SEQUENCE_REF_COMMIT, CANONICAL_PUBLICATION}; SRP {SEQUENCE_REF_COMMIT, STAGING_PUBLICATION, REMOTE_VERIFICATION, CANONICAL_PUBLICATION}; SRPO {SEQUENCE_REF_COMMIT, CANONICAL_PUBLICATION, POST_PUBLICATION_OBSERVATION}.
Every role_transforms value resolves to exactly one bound transform registration with that transform_id.
Every assertion's verifier_id resolves to exactly one bound verifier registration.
mandatory_floor and delegation_contract are present together or absent together, and the floor's delegation hash equals delegation_contract.
delegation_id is present iff delegation_contract is present, and equals the bound DelegationContract record's delegation_id (V-Q's impossibility).
The bound floor's mandatory_assertion_ids are a subset of the contract's assertion ids.

A delegated contract's allowed_scope.paths and artifact_paths lie inside the bound delegation's scope (D-26 containment), and its repository_id is among the delegation's repository_ids; otherwise only your authorship admits it (t-c04/t-c05 queue, not freeze).
eligibility is derived: HUMAN_REQUIRED iff any assertion's mode is HUMAN_ATTESTED; it is never a stored field.

supersession_provenance, when present, carries both supersedes_record and authorized_by (also enforced structurally), and the two digests may never be equal: they come from different hash domains (a record hash and an obj-38 object hash), so equality is an integrity alarm the schema cannot express.
A registration's artifact_root recomputes exactly from its closure manifest (D-32).
A registration declaring any service:* execution requirement is nondeterministic and may not be bound to a DETERMINISTIC assertion's verifier_id.
A payload's kind equals the domain label its hash was computed under, and its schema_version equals the label's version segment (v1).

Canonical-form admission: sets in canonical order without duplicate keys, maps with unique NFC keys, no null in Autobot-minted protocol objects (D-37 trust boundary), integers only within [0, 2^53-1], digests spelled sha256:<64 lowercase hex>, instants in the 24-char form, NFC strings, canonical paths and refs.

The Registry enforces repository_id uniqueness: a new RepositoryAuthorityDeclaration claiming an existing repository_id must come from the same operator; a different operator or a genuinely different logical repository must use a different repository_id. This is a Registry admission rule, not a structural schema constraint.
rules.note: The enforcement point is the Registry's admission logic (Chapter 2), not the schema; the SEM rule documents the invariant the Registry must uphold.
